## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-swift-50`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-swift-50 -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `swift-50.json`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `swift-50.json`
- `manifest.jsonl`

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

---

> **Mirror.** This is a copy of https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-swift-50 at revision `de43af1f406378b9c02ad38eb3df97b491ce70a6`, made 2026-09-29. The Hugging Face copy is the original; if the two differ, it wins.

# SWIFT 50 — honesty shell, no public 50

Honest census: live `GET https://councilof.ai/api/swift` reports **n=26** named banks (not 50). Swift cites 40+ in MVP construction; only 26 sourced to a real reachable dated press URL. Remaining ~14+ are **not** enumerated — no name invented to reach 50. Not clients. Not MEASURED.

- SWIFT census (live): https://councilof.ai/api/swift
- XRPL reader (live): https://councilof.ai/api/xrpl

This slug exists so inbound "swift-50" searches land on an honest page. **There is no public 50 list here.** Cite live `/api/swift` n=26. Prefer `csoai/gspc-swift-26`. **Not a certificate.**


## SWIFT banks = TARGETS (not MEASURED)

Live census: `GET https://councilof.ai/api/swift` → **n=26** · **n_measured=0** (3 LIVE · 9 COMMITTED · 14 DISCOVERED). Banks stay TARGETS. Never invent MEASURED grades, ISO/copybook/MT artifacts, or a public 50 list. Prefer `csoai/gspc-swift-26` as the Hub census mirror; live GET remains authority.


**This repository:** **NOT A BOARD MEASUREMENT** — this repository is a corpus, mirror or door published by CSOAI. It carries no axis score. The measured slots live on the board GET below.
